semiconductor_relevance: High — Woowon Technology is a key distributor of semiconductor equipment and materials, representing over 30 global technology partners.
summary: Woowon Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the distribution of advanced semiconductor equipment and materials, providing comprehensive support services to manufacturers and research institutions in Korea. Established in 1990, the company focuses on delivering tailored solutions and optimizing processes for its clients.

regional_presence.Korea: The company has its headquarters in Bundang and additional support centers in Hwaseong, Icheon, and Cheongju, focusing on the Korean semiconductor market.
